summary: media-uploads takes the local file as a positional argument (or --file), validates it before any request, previews request-free under --dry-run, and sends it as the multipart file field.
reason: The spec now declares the endpoint as multipart/form-data with a binary file part, so the generator emits multipart and replay-safe retries. The positional <file> form that scripts and docs use, and local-file validation before a dry run, remain hand-authored.
validated_outcome: TestMediaUpload* (multipart body, positional arity, missing/dir file without HTTP, dry run without HTTP, provider and transport errors) pass on the reprint.
